description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the performance gain for three different models under two types of supervision. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "GPT-4o", "Claude-3.5-Sonnet", and "Qwen2-72B-VL", presented in that specific order without an explicit sorting method, and features bolded text. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Performance Gain (+%)", using a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 30 with tick marks at regular intervals of 5. The chart features grouped bars, where each category on the horizontal axis has two adjacent bars representing the type of supervision, as indicated by a legend at the top. The left bar in each group represents "Strong Supervision" and is colored blue with white diagonal hatching, while the right bar represents "Weak Supervision" and is colored a lighter periwinkle blue with a subtle dotted texture. For GPT-4o, the Strong Supervision bar reaches approximately 24.3%, and the Weak Supervision bar is about 5.4%. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, the Strong Supervision bar is roughly 9.4%, and the Weak Supervision bar is approximately 3.6%. For Qwen2-72B-VL, the Strong Supervision bar is at 15.0%, and the Weak Supervision bar is approximately 5.4%. The tallest bar overall is the Strong Supervision bar for GPT-4o at approximately 24.3%, while the shortest is the Weak Supervision bar for Claude-3.5-Sonnet at roughly 3.6%. Across all three models, the Strong Supervision bar is consistently taller than the corresponding Weak Supervision bar.
